title: GTA 6 Introduces First-Ever Headphone Radio and Podcast Feature
description: According to media reports, GTA 6 will let players use headphones connected to smartphones to listen to radio stations and on-demand podcasts while on foot.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Lets Players Use Headphones for Radio and Podcasts On the Go

As anticipation builds for the next chapter in Rockstar Games' blockbuster franchise, new details regarding Grand Theft Auto 6 have emerged. According to a recent report by media outlet Eurogamer, GTA 6 will introduce a series-first feature that allows players to enjoy audio entertainment even when they are not driving a vehicle.

A Major Shift for the Open-World Franchise

Historically, the rich selection of radio stations, satirical commercials, and talk shows in the GTA series has been tied directly to vehicles. Once players stepped out of a car or motorcycle, the immersive audio experience was largely limited to ambient sounds and NPC chatter. 

However, Eurogamer reports that GTA 6 will change this by letting players wear headphones and earbuds connected to in-game smartphones. This means fans can continue listening to their favorite radio stations while walking, exploring, or navigating the open world on foot.

Introducing On-Demand Podcasts

In addition to traditional radio broadcasts, GTA 6 will also feature on-demand podcasts. As Eurogamer humorously noted, this allows players to binge true crime stories while committing true crime in the game world—a concept that fits right in with the satirical and immersive nature of the franchise.

Editor's Take

This new headphone feature is a fantastic quality-of-life and immersion upgrade for the GTA series. By breaking radio audio free from vehicles, Rockstar is ensuring that the incredible amount of music and talk-show content they create will be enjoyed much more frequently by players exploring the world on foot.
